propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate agreed 23 contract variations with shopfitting contractors within a £25,000 delegated limit in 2023 and chaired the June 2023 dispute meeting over delayed joinery.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the former head of property's written confirmation, the delegated limit and the minutes of the dispute meeting.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate planned each opening as a 14-week programme from site handover to first trading day.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the programme and the work sample shows a site milestone tracker.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate presented monthly programme status and cost reports to the development committee.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry describes the reporting directly.

expectedGap: Post-opening feedback was collected and summarised, but no lessons-learned review led by the candidate is documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the variation and dispute record from the reference check as supported evidence within its stated limit and year; describe the feedback summary as collection, not a led review.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate ran a structured lessons-learned review after an opening and which actions were carried into the next site.
